notes.title: New languages added!
notes.content:
The following [b]seven languages[/b] have been added to Unreal Life:

[list]
[*] Chinese (Simplified)
[*] Chinese (Traditional)
[*] Korean
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Italian
[*] Spanish
[/list]

We hope that even more people throughout the world will be able to enjoy Unreal Life's story!
